orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
WPSS 1519 of 2017 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Advocate for 
the petitioners. 
 Mr. Anil Dabral, Standing Counsel for 
the State/respondent nos.1 and 2. 
 None is present for respondent nos.3, 
4 and 5. 
 It is the contention of learned counsel 
for the petitioners that the petitioners are 
working as Sweepers with Nagar Panchayat 
Sultanpur, Udham Singh Nagar but they 
are not being paid their salary. 
 List this case on 26.02.2018. 
 Respondent no.5-Executive Officer, 
Nagar Panchayat Sultanpur, Udham Singh 
Nagar shall appear before this Court on the 
next date i.e. 26.02.2018 and shall apprise 
the Court as to why salary is not being to 
the petitioners. 
 Mr. Anil Dabral, Standing Counsel is 
requested to communicate this order to 
respondent no.5. 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 16.02.2018 
Rajni
